scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:ai-core
scripts.phase:alpha: cp config/phases/alpha.config.js config/phase.js && echo 'Switched to Alpha phase'
scripts.phase:beta: cp config/phases/beta.config.js config/phase.js && echo 'Switched to Beta phase'
scripts.phase:nexus: cp config/phases/nexus.config.js config/phase.js && echo 'Switched to Nexus phase'
scripts.setup: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ../ai-core && npm install
